review.notes: All 38 physical pages were scanned with a normalized PDF-text versus OCR containment diff, and every flagged line was triaged. Time budget ran out before coordinate-level verification of the remaining tables, so coverage is partial. Verified visually: physical p.9 (footnote 1) and physical p.30 Table 28 last two columns at 300 dpi (12 missing VATEX V→T cells). Confirmed non-defects: caption examples inside embedded Figures 4/6/9/10/13 images are figure-internal text; LOW_CONF-style underscores are Markdown escapes that render identically to the printed text; "capptions" in the Table 15 caption and "enocoder" on physical p.17 are typos the PDF itself prints (OCR text layer matches); CoNeTTE/ActivityNet/joint-query lines flagged by the diff exist in LaTeX-equivalent form; the p.28 Kinetics prompt templates are present. No unbalanced code fences; 27 HTML tables otherwise carry their printed values.
